note: Rags to Riches data. Positions are [x, z] metres from Ares Junction (same frame as the Mars city pack). Fictional, M-rated, no nudity.

tiers.name: Flats Nobody
tiers.blurb: Hab stack 9, a mattress and a busted heater. Everybody starts somewhere.

tiers.name: Olympus Row Regular
tiers.blurb: Neon, noise and a loft with a window that faces something other than a wall.

tiers.name: Helios Heights Royalty
tiers.blurb: Porter knows your name now. The gate opens before you reach it.

helios_gate.line: Porter: Residents and guests only. Come back when your name means something.

properties.name: Dust Bowl Noodle Cart
properties.pitch: Cheap broth, steady customers. The Rustline crew will want a cut.

properties.name: Back Bay Chop Shop
properties.pitch: Wrench needs a silent partner. Hot rovers in, clean parts out.

properties.name: Red Shift Lounge
properties.pitch: Two doors down from The Static. Door money, bar money, back-room money.

properties.name: Helios Crest Mansion
properties.pitch: Parties, private rentals, and a view of everyone you used to owe money to.

hustles.title: R2R: Scrap Run
hustles.intro: Wrench: You want in? Haul me the scrap behind the hab stacks. Don't ask whose it was.

steps.text: Grab the scrap behind the hab stacks
Drop it at the Back Bay door

hustles.title: R2R: Envelope for Marrow
hustles.intro: Marrow: One envelope, two stops, zero questions. Walk fast.

steps.text: Pick up the envelope from Marrow

hustles.title: R2R: Club Night Flyers
hustles.intro: Nyx: Paper the Row before doors open. Three corners. Go.

hustles.title: R2R: Gate Errand
hustles.intro: Porter: A resident left a case at the Junction. Bring it up the hill. Discreetly.

steps.text: Collect the case at Ozzie's Iron
Hand it to Porter at the gate

rover.line: Wrench: Fine. She's ugly, but she's yours.
